page: The Microsoft Azure M416ds_12_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MDSHighMemoryv3 family, architected for ultra-large enterprise compute demands. Running on Microsoft Hyper-V, the system supplies 416 dedicated Intel x86_64 vCPUs. Compute resources are coupled with 11,400 GB of total system memory, translating to a substantial density of 27.4 GB of RAM per core. The instance includes no GPU acceleration hardware, focusing entirely on high-capacity system memory and dedicated processor throughput.

For storage, the instance features an integrated 429 GB local SSD intended for swap space, temporary datasets, or high-speed local caching. In addition, the configuration is Premium Storage capable, facilitating high-performance managed disk connections for persistent enterprise data storage. The host profile provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, adhering to isolated enterprise networking topologies.

From an architectural perspective, the hardware profile represents an extreme memory-to-core allocation. While offering significant compute parallelism with 416 vCPUs, the primary architectural tradeoff is the small local SSD capacity relative to the multi-terabyte memory footprint, making reliance on external block storage mandatory for persistent databases. This resource balance makes the server exceptionally suited for massive in-memory databases such as SAP HANA, large-scale in-memory analytics, and enterprise data warehousing.
description: Microsoft Azure M416ds_12_v3 is an enterprise-tier, memory-optimized instance from the MDSHighMemoryv3 family designed for extreme-scale computing requirements. Built on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization, the system provides 416 dedicated x86_64 Intel vCPUs alongside an expansive 11,400 GB memory capacity, yielding approximately 27.4 GB of RAM per core. Accelerated graphics hardware is absent, reflecting a pure CPU and memory operational focus. For ephemeral caching and scratch storage, the instance incorporates a 429 GB local SSD, supplemented by architectural support for Premium Storage to handle persistent disk operations. Network architecture provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating configured gateway routing. Given the exceptionally high ratio of memory to compute resources, this instance delivers strong qualitative value for environments where dataset confinement to RAM is paramount, while the modest local SSD allocation shifts primary disk durability to attached storage. It is primarily engineered for massive in-memory databases, large-scale enterprise data warehouses, and intensive real-time transactional systems.
